column1: # at the port's frames and runs that oracle.py sound title pairs them with: the oracle's values only,
# hashes and statistics, never sound. limit: the game's count from which the plays aren't compared;
# plays: how many plays each player starts before it; window: a play's runs that the port must have, and
# the first run left out at the limit (- for the whole play, so that it must end where the oracle's
# does); play: a player's play, by the periodic runs since its start, the SHA-1 of the oracle's
# states of those runs (sound.py's player_state); status: what the ARM9 sees of the driver as
# the port frame ends, at the oracle frame it pairs with on the count; segment: a segment's lag (oracle
# frame = port frame + lag) and the oracle's RMS, peak and samples at full scale; envelope: the oracle's
# RMS by blocks of 4 frames; probe and exact: the SHA-1 of the oracle's samples at the loudest point and
# over the segment, at the port's samples plus the offset. Written by oracle.py sound title --update;
